summary: Iteration 2 retest + end-to-end verification of RF Photos (Expo web preview, 390x844). BOTH iteration_1 critical crashes are FIXED and verified. inspector.tsx now uses stable selectors (useStore(s=>s.versions) + useMemo filter) and no longer crashes; clipboard.tsx uses raw clipboard selector + useMemo sort and renders cleanly. Verified end-to-end: (1) Import 3 JPEGs via empty-library-state-action → 3 tiles. (2) Viewer → viewer-info-button opens Media Inspector with no 'Maximum update depth' error; inspector-hash-button computed a valid 64-char SHA-256 for imported data: URI photo (hash e.g. 57fe2eb0611cae764ee5cb920168ee8560a396676284d766054c0e4231125160). (3) /clipboard route loads directly without crash; viewer-clipboard-button adds items which appear in /clipboard (verified 3 clip rows after adding 3 photos). (4) Editor Create tab → create-tool-editor → editor-pick-button → picker media-tile-0 → picker-done-button → editor-tab-filters → filter-preset-mono → editor-tab-crop → crop-rotate-button → undo → redo → editor-save-button all work. library-count went 3 → 4 and /timemachine shows 1 version-* with compare-mode-side toggle working. (5) Collage: create-hero-collage → collage-pick-button → select 2 → done → collage-text-input ('Hello') → collage-save-project-button → project-* persists in Create tab → collage-export-button toasts 'Exported 2160×2160 to your library'. (6) Vault: /vault setup PIN 123456 twice (vault-setup-pad + vault-confirm-pad) → vault-add-button → picker select 1 → done → vault-item-0 visible; home library-count correctly decreases (3 → 2) hiding vaulted item. (7) Agent: library-agent → 'favourite photos today' → agent-preview-button shows agent-plan-card with agent-affected-count='2 item(s) affected' → agent-run-button → dialog-confirm-button → agent-undo-* appears and tapping shows 'Undone' toast. Unknown command 'blah' shows agent-error 'I didn't recognise that command'. (8) Search tag: viewer-notes-button → tags input filled 'beach' → viewer-save-details-button → /search 'beach' returns 2 media results with search-why='Why the first result matched: tag contains “beach”'. (9) Automation: multi-select via selection-batch-button → /automation → automation-dry-run shows automation-dry-results → automation-run → dialog-confirm-button → 2 automation-result-* rows. (10) Smart album: /search 'photos' → search-smart-button → Albums tab shows 'Your smart albums' with user-smart-* card; opening it shows 3 collection tiles and collection-pause-rule-button toggles OK. ONE MINOR SIDE-EFFECT (not a regression): vault-lock-button after a browser navigation away/back can be absent because the vault re-locks automatically on remount — expected security behaviour. No React red screens, no infinite loops, no uncaught pageerrors across all 10 flows.

react_native_issues.issue: Expo warning on every screen: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — cosmetic but spammy in console. Audit src/components/ui and src/theme shadow* usages.
Expo warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — appears on home and picker screens.

action_items: No functional action required — all iteration_1 fixes verified and all 10 requested flows pass end-to-end.
Optional cleanup: migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence console warnings (cosmetic only, no behavioural issue).

Optional UX polish: when the user re-enters /vault after a navigation (vault re-locks automatically), consider surfacing a 'Vault re-locked for safety' hint before showing the unlock pad so testers/users aren't surprised that vault-lock-button is briefly absent.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix pattern in inspector.tsx:18-21 is clean: select raw s.versions / s.events, derive filtered arrays with useMemo keyed on id. Confirmed no more getSnapshot caching warning.
Fix pattern in clipboard.tsx:14-15 is clean: select raw s.clipboard, sort inside useMemo. Confirmed no more infinite loop.

Picker screen renders alongside the (tabs)/index media grid, so two media-tile-0 elements exist in the DOM when the picker is open. Tests must scope with .last() or query inside the picker container. Not a bug, but worth noting for future test authors; could optionally add a 'picker-tile-{n}' alias for clarity.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 10 requested flows passed (10/10). Only minor cosmetic console deprecation warnings remain.

seed_data_creation: Three generated JPEGs (640x480, solid colours) at /tmp/test_images/photo_{0,1,2}.jpg fed via page.set_input_files to the hidden expo-image-picker file input.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Web preview URL: https://rf-gallery-ai.preview.emergentagent.com (390x844 mobile viewport). Import via [data-testid='empty-library-state-action'] (first time) or [data-testid='home-import-button'] + page.expect_file_chooser + set_files with PIL-generated JPEGs. Picker reuses testID 'media-tile-{index}' (NOT 'picker-tile-{index}') and because home grid stays mounted under the tabs layout you MUST use page.locator('[data-testid="media-tile-N"]').last to click the picker's instance. Tab bar testIDs are 'tab-photos' / 'tab-albums' / 'tab-create' / 'tab-library' (NOT 'tabs-*'). PIN pad testIDs: 'vault-setup-pad' / 'vault-confirm-pad' / 'vault-unlock-pad' as containers, 'pin-key-0..9' and 'pin-key-back' for keys; add ~180ms wait between keys and wait_for_selector between the setup→confirm phase transitions. Vault re-locks automatically when the vault screen remounts after direct navigation. Agent affected-count element renders only after agent-preview-button. Smart album flow: /search → search-smart-button → optional dialog-input + dialog-confirm-button → navigate to home then tab-albums to see 'user-smart-*' (not visible from /search as /search is outside the (tabs) layout).
rca_of_issue: N/A — iteration_1 bugs were fully resolved by main agent before this iteration. Verification confirmed stable useSyncExternalStore snapshots (no 'Maximum update depth' / 'getSnapshot should be cached' warnings during 10 independent flows across inspector and clipboard screens).
